_doc: Alaska and Hawaii (Manu, 2026-11-17): the recommended trips of the US Pacific states, written by hand like ../trips.json. Alaska has three season bands (summer May-September for the parks, December-March for skiing and the aurora, October-November and April for the aurora only); Hawaii one route per length all year. elevation/coords: where you sleep (Denali's entrance, Volcano village, Hāna town), not the park's middle.

journeys.name: Alaska
journeys.blurb: Grizzlies and the mountain in Denali, glaciers falling into the fjords, Kennecott's mill town, the Inside Passage in summer and the northern lights in winter.

journeys.name: Hawaii
journeys.blurb: Pearl Harbor and Waikiki, sunrise on Haleakalā, the Nā Pali cliffs of Kauaʻi, manta rays off Kona and the craters of Kīlauea.

trips.title: Alaska in a week: Denali and Kenai Fjords
trips.why: Anchorage, the bus into Denali's tundra for grizzlies and the mountain, a flight from Talkeetna, then a glacier cruise in Kenai Fjords from Seward.
trips.note: Mid-May to mid-September: long days (about 19 hours of light in June), 12-22 °C, rain likely on the coast. The Denali buses, the glacier cruises and the McCarthy lodges run only now; June to August is the peak, September brings autumn colours, the first aurora and snow on the passes.

trips.title: Two weeks of Alaska: Denali, Fairbanks, Valdez and Kenai Fjords
trips.why: Talkeetna and Denali, Fairbanks, the Richardson Highway past Thompson Pass to Valdez's Columbia Glacier, then Seward's fjords and back up Turnagain Arm.
trips.note: Mid-May to mid-September: long days (about 19 hours of light in June), 12-22 °C, rain likely on the coast. The Denali buses, the glacier cruises and the McCarthy lodges run only now; June to August is the peak, September brings autumn colours, the first aurora and snow on the passes.

trips.title: Three weeks round Alaska: Denali, Kennecott and the Kenai
trips.why: The great loop: Talkeetna, Denali and Fairbanks, the gravel road to the Kennecott mill and Root Glacier, Valdez, Kenai Fjords, Homer's bears and Alyeska.
trips.note: Mid-May to mid-September: long days (about 19 hours of light in June), 12-22 °C, rain likely on the coast. The Denali buses, the glacier cruises and the McCarthy lodges run only now; June to August is the peak, September brings autumn colours, the first aurora and snow on the passes.

trips.title: Alaska in four weeks, from Denali to the Inside Passage
trips.why: The whole loop from Denali and Kennecott to Kenai Fjords and Homer, then a flight to Juneau's whales and glacier and the gold rush railway of Skagway.
trips.note: Mid-May to mid-September: long days (about 19 hours of light in June), 12-22 °C, rain likely on the coast. The Denali buses, the glacier cruises and the McCarthy lodges run only now; June to August is the peak, September brings autumn colours, the first aurora and snow on the passes.

trips.title: Alaska's winter in a week: Alyeska and the Fairbanks aurora
trips.why: Anchorage, two days of skiing at Alyeska above Turnagain Arm, then three nights in Fairbanks under the auroral oval, with Chena Hot Springs.
trips.note: December to March: aurora season. -25 to -10 °C in Fairbanks, -10 to -5 °C around Anchorage; 4-6 hours of light in December, 12 by March. Skiing at Alyeska. The Aurora Winter Train links Anchorage, Talkeetna and Fairbanks on weekends; drive only with winter experience. Denali buses and cruises stop.

trips.title: Two winter weeks: ski, Talkeetna and the northern lights
trips.why: Anchorage and its sled dog races, skiing at Alyeska, Talkeetna and a flight round Denali, then six Fairbanks nights for the aurora, dog sledding and hot springs.
trips.note: December to March: aurora season. -25 to -10 °C in Fairbanks, -10 to -5 °C around Anchorage; 4-6 hours of light in December, 12 by March. Skiing at Alyeska. The Aurora Winter Train links Anchorage, Talkeetna and Fairbanks on weekends; drive only with winter experience. Denali buses and cruises stop.

trips.title: Three weeks of Alaskan winter
trips.why: Anchorage, the eagles of Homer Spit, a long ski stay at Alyeska, Talkeetna under Denali, then eight nights in Fairbanks for many chances at the aurora.
trips.note: December to March: aurora season. -25 to -10 °C in Fairbanks, -10 to -5 °C around Anchorage; 4-6 hours of light in December, 12 by March. Skiing at Alyeska. The Aurora Winter Train links Anchorage, Talkeetna and Fairbanks on weekends; drive only with winter experience. Denali buses and cruises stop.

trips.title: Four slow weeks of Alaskan winter
trips.why: A slow winter: Anchorage's festivals, Homer, a week of skiing and spa at Alyeska, Talkeetna, and nine Fairbanks nights for the aurora, dogs and ice art.
trips.note: December to March: aurora season. -25 to -10 °C in Fairbanks, -10 to -5 °C around Anchorage; 4-6 hours of light in December, 12 by March. Skiing at Alyeska. The Aurora Winter Train links Anchorage, Talkeetna and Fairbanks on weekends; drive only with winter experience. Denali buses and cruises stop.

trips.title: Northern lights in a week: Anchorage, Talkeetna and Fairbanks
trips.why: Anchorage's museums and Turnagain Arm, Talkeetna and a flight round Denali when it is clear, then Fairbanks for the aurora and Chena Hot Springs.
trips.note: October, November and April, between the seasons: aurora nights in Fairbanks, first or last snow, 0 to -15 °C. The glacier cruises, the Denali buses and many lodges are closed, Seward and Homer are quiet; Alyeska's skiing runs about December to mid-April. A trip for the northern lights, not the parks.

trips.title: Two weeks of Alaska out of season
trips.why: Anchorage, Exit Glacier and the SeaLife Center at Seward, the quiet Homer Spit, Talkeetna, then Fairbanks for the northern lights.
trips.note: October, November and April, between the seasons: aurora nights in Fairbanks, first or last snow, 0 to -15 °C. trips.title: Three weeks of Alaska between the seasons
trips.why: The Kenai peninsula without the crowds from Seward and Homer, Talkeetna, then a week in Fairbanks for the aurora, hot springs and the Museum of the North.
trips.note: October, November and April, between the seasons: aurora nights in Fairbanks, first or last snow, 0 to -15 °C. trips.title: Four quiet weeks of Alaska
trips.why: A slow month: Anchorage, the spa and forest trails of Girdwood, Seward and Homer, Talkeetna, then eight Fairbanks nights for the northern lights.
trips.note: October, November and April, between the seasons: aurora nights in Fairbanks, first or last snow, 0 to -15 °C. The glacier cruises, the Denali buses and many lodges are closed, Seward and Homer are quiet; Alyeska's skiing runs about December to mid-April. A trip for the northern lights, not the parks.

trips.title: Hawaii in a week: Oahu and Maui
trips.why: Pearl Harbor, Diamond Head and the North Shore on Oahu, then a flight to Maui for sunrise on Haleakalā, Molokini's reef and the south coast beaches.
trips.note: All year: 26-31 °C by the sea, the water 24-27 °C. April-May and September-October are the driest and quietest; December to April brings the humpbacks and the big north shore waves, with more rain on the windward sides. Hurricane season June-November, direct hits rare. Book Haleakalā sunrise and Hāʻena ahead.

trips.title: Two weeks on three islands: Oahu, Maui and the Big Island
trips.why: Oahu, Maui with Haleakalā and a night in Hāna, then the Big Island: manta rays and Kealakekua Bay from Kona, and Kīlauea's craters from Volcano village.
trips.note: All year: 26-31 °C by the sea, the water 24-27 °C. trips.title: Three weeks of Hawaii: four islands
trips.why: Oahu, then Kauaʻi's Nā Pali cliffs and Waimea Canyon from Hanalei and Poʻipū, Maui and the Road to Hāna, and the Big Island's Kona coast and volcano.

trips.title: Hawaii in four weeks, island by island
trips.why: Four islands slowly: Oahu, Kauaʻi's north and south shores, Maui and Hāna, then the Big Island all round from Kona and Volcano to Hilo's waterfalls.
